verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official CLI for local development and deploying from the terminal. A probe confirms a dedicated CLI guide, and the agents docs describe a single command that installs the CLI and configures agent support (skills, MCP, auth), which ties the CLI directly to AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: detailed command-level evidence of what the CLI exposes for agent/scripted use (e.g., JSON output, non-interactive auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working in agent workflows.
